short350: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) in Nigerian Pidgin — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in blue, the Son's in red, the Spirit's in purple. A complete 66-book Nigerian Pidgin Bible, paperback and hardcover, made to be given.
Papa Heart Bible: di first Bible wey dem print wey you fit see who dey talk. Our Papa words dey blue, di Pikin words dey red, and di Spirit words dey purple.

For more than one hundred years, red letters don show where di Pikin dey talk. But our Papa dey talk pass — for dis Naija Bible, 149,731 words inside 5,615 verses — and until now, every one of im words, dem print am with di same black ink wey dem use print di family lists. E don dey talk all di time; no Bible don ever show you where.

Di colour na mark of ownership, no be mark of quotation. Our Papa words still be im own for any mouth wey carry dem faithfully; words wey e never talk, dem no dey colour dem at all; di story part still dey black.

When im disciples ask how to pray, di Pikin no give dem formula. E give dem Papa: “Our Papa wey dey for heaven, make your name dey honored as holy” (Matthew 6:9). Everything for dis Bible come from dat one word. We dey cry, “Abba! Papa!” (Romans 8:15).

E no dey far. E no dey disappointed for you. Na im be your Papa for heaven, and you be im pikin wey e love. If “papa” no be word wey dey give you comfort, dis Bible na especially for you: di Papa wey dis pages show no be copy of broken human papa — na im be di original, di Papa wey na from am every family for heaven and for earth take dem name.

Introduction dey open every book, and 1,354 notes dey serve di reader, no be di scholar. Dedication page dey carry di name of di person wey you give am. Di complete Bible — 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses, nothing cut comot.

Faithful translation from di original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; every edition na from di Father's Heart Bible™ dem translate am. 6 x 9 inches, paperback and hardcover, full colour. Gift, keepsake, inheritance.
For every family and church wey dey speak Pidgin — for Nigeria, for West Africa, and for anywhere for di world — make dem hear di Papa voice for dem own language.
Receive di Papa. Hear im voice. Im heart dey for you.

faq.q: Is the Nigerian Pidgin edition the complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, Genesis to Revelation, in Nigerian Pidgin, 952 pages, full color throughout, in hardcover and paperback.

faq.q: How was the Nigerian Pidgin edition translated?
faq.a: A faithful translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek; each edition is translated from the Father's Heart Bible™. The Father's Heart Bible™ itself is translated from the original languages; the Nigerian Pidgin edition is translated from it, so it follows the same text and carries the same Divine Voice Color.

In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read the Nigerian Pidgin text before I buy?
faq.a: Yes. The whole Nigerian Pidgin Bible is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read/pcm.
